title: Radio and infantry integration under Claude’s lead
summary: Radio commands, push-to-talk and local speech are reconciled with Claude’s look-people figures, SDF hands, render LODs and XR camera fix. This report records the integration checks and remaining visual limits on ngc/look-voices. Third-person grip fit remains explicitly open for the separate follow-up Claude assigned after this merge handoff.
reproduce: In the assigned agent-acb3f3f66119cd838 worktree, merge fixed input f8abdbb into ngc/look-voices. Run node tools/check.mjs syntax and types. From tools run CHROME_PATH=/home/jayjay/.cache/chs/chrome.sh node snap.mjs scenes/voices.mjs, scenes/smoke.json, scenes/radioops.mjs, scenes/radiorecovery.mjs and scenes/radiofiguremerge.mjs. Preview poses and mission terminal states are scripted fixtures, as described below. Third-person grip inspection: scenes/radiogripmerge.mjs. DOM interaction: CHROME_PATH=/home/jayjay/.cache/chs/chrome.sh node tools/radiodeskbench.mjs. Final accepted game captures share hash2c86e9b56cba59d6cba5f5ec6fa7d99d81093a275448f18325f19f493208cb97; the original source-inventory failure and pre-profile figure are explicitly diagnostic.

changes.title: One body and hand pipeline
changes.change: Claude’s welded SDF hands and attachMarine body remain the default visible geometry. The merge ports grip/wrist fitting, corresponding open/rail morph targets, gait, planted feet, posture blending and state resets onto them. Detailed weapons, per-pixel camouflage, baked crews and instanced crowd LOD remain. The old alternate garment body helper is removed.
changes.observed: The LP body keeps a continuous silhouette, camouflage and coherent stand/walk/prone/seated poses. The prone pelvis correction clears the belt pouches. Final first-person profiles remove the large protruding M203 support-thumb cap, move the M60 hand30mm rearward and clear the LAW sight window. Small M203 fingertip slivers and imperfect M60 furniture contact remain.
checks: 886 first-person pose/geometry checks pass, including deformed thumb clearance and nail winding; maximum cuff error 2.33e-16 m.
Seven body checks pass, including 192 phases across three LODs. Support soles range from -1.7 to +12.3 mm; prone body minimum is +4.5 mm.
Four material modes and 60 weapon/state combinations pass Node contracts.
Focused rendered fixture passes 9/9 assertions with no browser errors.
Nail-patch winding checks pass for both hands, three grip radii, trigger on/off and the directed thumb profiles.
limitations: Still images do not prove continuous animation or a full gait cycle. The seated fixture has no chair and partly crops the boots.

The mapped SDF morph is an authored approximation. Initial default-pose comparison with independent SDF meshes found p95 distances of 1.93–2.80 mm and maximum distances of 9.99–13.25 mm. These are initial mapping measurements, not a guarantee for every new profile.
Inherited wide glossy eyes, puckered lips, jaw/neck junction and imperfect third-person grips remain.

Visible high-detail near body plus rifle is 31,836 triangles; low-detail near is 26,144. The 15k near-figure aspiration is not met. This merge preserves Claude’s geometry and makes no performance claim.

M203 fingertips can still show small skin slivers against furniture. The M60 hand now reaches the forearm front lip, with some fingers around the adjoining barrel/gas assembly. The grips are improved but not intersection-free.

changes.title: Third-person grip limits remain visible
changes.change: The people preview can select production weapons and classes with fixed weapon-local cameras. This reveals the separate static tpHand/body pose path rather than substituting first-person hands.
changes.observed: Six third-person close-ups pass their structural/camera assertions but fail visual grip-fit review: M203 furniture intersects the palm, GL-mode hands do not match a convincing launcher grasp, M60 support remains forward and LAW palms intersect the tube. First-person profile fixes do not alter these poses.
checks: 9/9 checks establish intended weapon/class, M203 furniture and one visible LP body; they do not establish correct grip contact.
limitations: Claude explicitly directed recording these four third-person fit cases OPEN in this merge, then correcting them as a separate follow-up after the tested HEAD is posted.
An oblique LAW sight view is not an eye-line reticle test.

changes.title: Radio commands survive the renderer merge
changes.change: The main loop retains radio updates before simulation early returns, PTT input masking and new-game resets. Command readbacks, map marks, paid requests and actual mission outcomes remain connected to the live game. The radio desk keeps Orders, Missions, Traffic and Settings.
changes.observed: The production radio desk passes 16/16 DOM/parser/transaction checks. Desktop readback controls and the 390px Orders layout stay inside the viewport. The live radio operations scene passes 13/13: CAP requests await readback, confirmation spends materiel and queues a real Tomcat, duplicate confirmation cannot spend twice, and actual Marine squads receive formation, cease-fire and marked-point movement orders. Pause cancels unconfirmed requests. Recovery passes 9/9: completed, cancelled and failed field-support missions report their actual outcome instead of inferring success from fuel level. Required smoke passes 5/5 on the final frozen source; the final voice rerun passes 29/29, both without browser or console errors.
checks: Required smoke5/5 passes with no browser/console errors.
limitations: Automated command transcripts bypass physical speech recognition. The radio recovery fixture sets terminal flags on real drop missions; it does not fly a full resupply sortie.

changes.title: Speech and server contracts
changes.change: Quieter filtered speech and local synthesis are retained. Both local speech endpoints keep opt-in capability reporting and same-origin guards alongside desktop/XR benchmark storage. Real callback contracts, DOM narrowing and worklet globals make the changed radio/input files compatible with Claude’s checkJs ratchet.
changes.observed: Node checks pass: PTT 23, parser/native lifecycle 38, radio net 56, operations 46, bank/hooks 19, recognition lifecycle 18, local synthesis 21 and HOTAS 3 groups. All 12 server checks pass, including actual benchmark storage beside the speech routes. Syntax passes 609/609. Full semantic typing reports 578 diagnostics against the unchanged 606 ceiling. Changed voice/HOTAS and body modules have none; the detailed weapon file retains one inherited tuple/spread diagnostic.
checks: No type suppressions or baseline increase.
Inherited XR eye-camera handling reads matrixWorld without updating the render-time camera.

Final voices 29/29: live role call-outs, no overlapping utterances, urgent interruption, quiet bus and rendered radio band-pass, distance fade, wall muffling, pause/OFF cancellation, bounded queues and no-installed-voices silence.
limitations: The total 578 diagnostics are existing project debt, so the project is not type-clean.
This integration rerun uses generated speech in headless Chrome. It does not establish subjective voice quality, physical microphone operation in Opera GX or physical HOTAS/headset behavior.
No new voice pack or external speech service is introduced.
DOM, server and speech lifecycle checks were run after radio typing reconciliation; subsequent source changes only affected figure profiles and their preview/fixtures.
Claude remains project lead and rendering owner. This branch is handed back for review and integration; main is unchanged and nothing is pushed.
Captures run on shared-host SwiftShader while other authorized agents use browsers. No frame-rate improvement or performance-budget compliance is claimed.
These previews are procedural game art, not a claim of AAA character fidelity.

The initial voices run passed 29/29 assertions but failed source provenance: staging an already-deleted obsolete game file changed the harness file inventory during capture. It is retained as a diagnostic; the report includes a separate rerun on the final frozen source.
XR camera preservation was reviewed against f8abdbb; deckcrew.js is unchanged from that input. Claude will run XR/xrgameplay after integrating the posted HEAD. No new headset result is claimed here.
